lessons.title: Strategy for ideation
lessons.vector_text: invention_design. ideation. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Translate the need into functions and constraints, generate genuinely different principles rather than cosmetic variants, then eliminate concepts that violate hard constraints.
anti_patterns: counting minor variants as separate inventions
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Cluster concepts by underlying physical or logical principle and require distinct mechanisms.

lessons.title: Strategy for architecture
lessons.vector_text: invention_design. architecture. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Define functions, interfaces, flows, states and failure boundaries before selecting components; make dependencies explicit and preserve replaceable modules.
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Remove or replace one module and verify interface and failure consequences.

lessons.title: Strategy for tradeoff
lessons.vector_text: invention_design. tradeoff. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Define decision criteria, units, constraints and uncertainty; compare alternatives on the same assumptions and expose Pareto tradeoffs instead of hiding them in one score.
anti_patterns: weighted score with arbitrary hidden weights
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Vary weights and uncertain inputs and report whether the preferred region changes.

lessons.title: Strategy for novelty
lessons.vector_text: invention_design. novelty. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Decompose the concept into claims and combinations; distinguish technical novelty from usefulness and from patentability; search for prior mechanisms before claiming novelty.
anti_patterns: new wording treated as new invention
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Attempt to map every claimed novel element to known prior mechanisms or combinations.

lessons.title: Strategy for validation plan
lessons.vector_text: invention_design. validation_plan. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Map each critical claim to the cheapest decisive evidence step, ordered from analysis to simulation to bench to representative test; define pass/fail criteria in advance.
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Identify the highest-risk assumption and design a smaller test capable of killing it early.

lessons.title: Strategy for measurement
lessons.vector_text: data_statistics. measurement. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Define measurand, instrument, calibration, sampling process, resolution and uncertainty budget before analysis.
anti_patterns: precision digits mistaken for measurement accuracy
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Repeat or cross-calibrate measurements and propagate dominant uncertainty sources.

lessons.title: Strategy for inference
lessons.vector_text: data_statistics. inference. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: State population, sampling mechanism, estimand, assumptions and uncertainty; distinguish descriptive sample statistics from population inference.
anti_patterns: sample result generalized without sampling assumptions
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Stress assumptions and check interval or conclusion under plausible alternative models.

lessons.title: Strategy for correlation causation
lessons.vector_text: data_statistics. correlation_causation. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Quantify association while separately examining temporal order, confounding, selection effects and plausible intervention mechanisms.
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Construct a confounder or selection mechanism capable of producing the observed association.

lessons.title: Strategy for forecast
lessons.vector_text: data_statistics. forecast. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Define horizon, target, information cutoff and baseline; use backtesting or rolling validation, report calibration and degradation with horizon.
anti_patterns: testing forecast on information unavailable at prediction time
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Backtest strictly using only information available at each historical cutoff.

lessons.title: Strategy for robustness
lessons.vector_text: data_statistics. robustness. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Identify influential observations, assumptions and preprocessing choices; rerun reasonable alternatives and report conclusions that survive.
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Perform sensitivity, leave-one-group-out or specification-curve checks appropriate to the data.
